quotes.text: Account type: ✓ Merchant, ✗ Platform or marketplace (Connect)
PayPay-side authorization expires 5 minutes after redirect. Separately, Stripe expires the payment attempt 1 hour after payment-attempt creation and reports `payment_intent_payment_attempt_expired`.
PayPay refunds are never processed as reversals.
Radar support for PayPay is in private preview. Contact Stripe to request access.
An eligible custom integration can instead present a separate custom QR variant while keeping its page open.

old_evidence.text: Other categories at the discretion of PayPay
Refunds for PayPay payments complete instantly.

findings: Both dated method pages describe the Japan-origin wallet, JPY, same 50–1,000,000 JPY limits, standard payout scheduling and unavailable recurring, Connect, disputes and manual capture. November explicitly limits payment acceptance to domestic JP commerce and single use, with no Setup Intents, setup_future_usage or off-session. The API and UI product-matrix distinctions retain Payment Links, Checkout and Payment Element while specifying full-page, embedded and in-app support and no Express Checkout Element, Terminal or Billing. Radar requires private-preview access.

JP merchant B2B/B2C applicants can have instant provisional activation and post-activation review. The site needs matching onboarding information, identified products/services and payment flow, digital offerings disclosure where relevant and complete SCTA page. It prohibits MCC 6051 and permits an appeal for restrictions.

Customer chooses PayPay, opens it via desktop QR/web or mobile app/browser, authorizes separately with PayPay and can return automatically or manually. Stripe immediately confirms success or failure. Standard redirect differs from the eligible custom QR variant that keeps the page open; the two expiration clocks have different triggers and actors.

Merchant full or partial refunds submitted through Dashboard/API within 365 days complete instantly, cannot be canceled, and are handled by PayPay back to the original PayPay balance or linked funding source without reversal. Stripe's Refund status and webhook types are separate; failed refund restores merchant Stripe balance and needs another refund method. PayPay can send customer dispute inquiries to merchant for a refund, with no standard chargeback or dispute debit.
Stripe passes a computed descriptor to the PayPay partner integration, which controls display. The linked Connect descriptor guidance does not imply PayPay Connect eligibility.
substantive_changes: Add provisional eligibility and post-activation website review conditions, explicit domestic coverage, separate five-minute authorization and one-hour Stripe payment-attempt timers, and conditional custom QR route.
Add expanded supported/unsupported operational matrix, Radar private preview, refund destination/no reversal/no cancellation and the two-party statement descriptor boundary.

Correct PayPal to PayPay for the older discretion language and retain it dated, while the November table expressly lists MCC 6051. Distinguish minor heading/table and enablement-link reorganizations from substantive content.
historical_claims_to_preserve: 2026-05-07 method raw reports no Connect, while the separate May wallets table row and footnote explicitly show request-an-invite Connect. Keep both attributed documents and dates without asserting that either establishes live account eligibility or an invite shutdown.

May gives instant full or partial refund within 365 days, final Refund status and return of failed funds plus an alternate refund path, and payment-only Checkout and no Express Checkout Element. May also mentions other categories at PayPay’s discretion.
conflicts: Mapped source says PayPal discretion, but May raw line 94 says PayPay. November supplies a defined prohibited MCC and a restriction appeal route instead of restating the same broad wording.

Source and wallets concept mix the method-page no-Connect position with a separate invite-only claim. November explicitly excludes platform/marketplace accounts and Connect. Qualify the dated cross-source conflict, rather than infer invite availability.
Source treats redirect as unconditional, while November describes both standard redirect and a separately eligible custom QR variant. Preserve the conditional scope.
unresolved_questions: November does not specify the custom QR eligibility criteria or implementation contract, demonstrate descriptor rendering, or establish a current price beyond its pricing link.

Whether older separately documented Connect invitations still apply to any accounts remains unverified. The method overview and historical wallet table supply different scoped statements, and the descriptor guidance does not settle them.

findings: Retain dated May support and add November eligibility, timers, conditional QR, API/UI/Radar scope, refund mechanics and descriptor actor boundary. Add reciprocal Stripe Wallets concept link.
conflicts: Correct PayPal misattribution and resolve the presentation of no Connect and invite-only wording by documenting the source scopes and dates.
source_assessments.reason: Material eligibility, timing, refund and flow details are missing, and the existing unqualified redirect and mixed Connect statements can misstate the November overview.

answers.Q1: At https://docs.stripe.com/payments/paypay, source-stripe-paypay.md describes a one-time JPY wallet payment for a JP merchant and JP customer. Old raw lines 10–66 establish customer initiation, standard payout, no recurring or Connect and compatible payment-only UIs. New raw lines 16–59 add instant provisional access, possible review of the merchant and its SCTA-bearing website, domestic limits, a PayPay five-minute post-redirect authorization clock and Stripe’s one-hour attempt-expiry clock. New raw lines 137–157 describe selection, app/browser/QR opening, separate authorization, return and Stripe’s immediate success/failure confirmation, with a separate custom QR variant for eligible integrations. Old raw lines 96–103 and new raw lines 86–106 retain full or partial instant 365-day refunds and add original funding-source routing, no reversal or cancellation, and continued Refund status and webhook tracking.
answers.Q2: At https://docs.stripe.com/payments/paypay, source-stripe-paypay.md should distinguish template/heading changes and navigation links from eligibility, timing and capability changes. Old raw lines 36–38 say no Connect, and the separate May wallet table in raw/stripe-wallets-2025.md lines 68–88 qualifies Connect with an invite. New raw lines 18–31 and 118–133 rule out ordinary platform/marketplace and Connect product eligibility while specifying private-preview Radar. Preserve that dated conflict without asserting an invite is currently available or revoked. Old raw lines 89–94 attribute additional restrictions to PayPay, not PayPal, while new raw lines 33–40 specify prohibited MCC 6051. New raw lines 153–159 qualify standard redirect and partner-controlled descriptor display. Refresh the PayPay source entry in wiki/stripe-index.md and the PayPay text and source route in wiki/concepts/stripe-wallets.md, and add the reciprocal link from source to concept.
